entities.summary: Oliver "Ollie" Lang is an American professional paintball player. Widely regarded as the greatest player in the history of the sport, Lang has won over 50 professional titles across several decades. He is a founding member of San Diego Dynasty and was the first player in the sport's history to receive a $100,000 individual contract salary.
